root_cause.acceptance_2_4_x: Generated acceptance in 2.4.x used duplicated ^2\.(3\.0|4\.0)$ feature gates. 2.5.0 replaced them with one reviewed fail-closed contract classifier.
hotfix_2_5_1: 2.5.0 compared Docker inspect capability arrays literally as NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW. Docker 29.8 can expose the equivalent canonical CAP_NET_ADMIN/CAP_NET_RAW representation, causing NODE_CAPABILITY_POLICY false-negative.
2.5.0 passed ss scoped IPv4 text such as 127.0.0.53%lo directly to IPv4Address, causing PUBLIC_TCP_LISTENERS_POLICY=NOT_VERIFIED INVALID_LOCAL_DATA instead of treating it as loopback.
hotfix_2_5_2: Before the first reboot, rw-node can own one AF_INET6 wildcard NODE_PORT socket with bindv6only=0 while real IPv4 connects succeed; ss -4 alone therefore produced a false MISSING_EXPECTED_PORTS=2222.

After reboot/live profile activation, rw-core legitimately binds the reviewed generated VLESS listener as 0.0.0.0:443; 2.5.1 listener audit incorrectly required the concrete public IPv4 and produced BIND_ADDRESS_MISMATCH PORTS=443.

hotfix_2_5_1.capability_policy: Normalize only an optional leading CAP_ before exact comparison; require exactly NET_ADMIN added, exactly NET_RAW dropped, and no-new-privileges. Extra capabilities still fail.
hotfix_2_5_1.public_listener_policy: Strip one validated %interface display scope before IPv4 classification; loopback remains ignored and non-loopback unexpected public listeners still fail.
